entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Crash when bringing app to foreground by tapping Android notification #33187
  • Android WebView is recreated on background/resume even when Activity and Page are alive #33184
  • WebView Scroll Position Not updated properly after scrolling on Android and iOS #33180
  • [.NET 10] iOS App Extensions (UI/Non-UI) are not code-signed during build despite correct Provisioning settings #33175
  • Implement Material3 support for Button #33172
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • When TitleBar.IsVisible = false the caption buttons become unresponsive on Windows #33171

Closed

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `maui/inflight/current` can't be mirrored to Azdo fast forward branch #32977
  • DataTemplateSelector in CollectionView does not size/measure items properly #8803
  • Make MauiDoneAccessoryView DoneButton accessible #32825
  • [iOS] Text Color of the Entry, TimePicker and SearchBar is not properly worked on dynamic Scenarios #32885
  • Error NETSDK1178 #33153

Created

  • Update PatchVersion from 20 to 30 #33186
  • December 22nd, Candidate #33185
  • [iOS] Fix WebView GoBack/GoForward not working for HtmlWebViewSource #33183
    partner/syncfusion

    community ✨

    platform/ios, community ✨
